fullName: Village of Oak Park Board of Trustees
facts: Uses the Village Manager form of government: the board sets policy and hires a professional manager
Made up of an elected Village President and six trustees
Elected officials serve four-year staggered terms
Municipal elections are held in April of odd-numbered years

fullName: Oak Park Elementary School District 97 Board of Education
facts: Oversees 10 schools: 8 elementary and 2 middle schools
Middle schools are Brooks and Julian
The board has seven members elected to four-year terms

fullName: Oak Park and River Forest High School District 200 Board of Education
facts: Governs Oak Park and River Forest High School, serving both villages
Comprises seven members elected by the community
Adopts, enforces, and monitors district policies
Earned the Illinois Association of School Boards 2025 Governance Recognition

fullName: Park District of Oak Park Board of Park Commissioners
facts: Five elected commissioners oversee the Park District, which dates to 1912
Manages 18 parks totaling 84 acres, including Austin Gardens and Scoville Park
Runs two outdoor pools, Rehm and Ridgeland Common, and the Paul Hruby Ice Arena
Operates three historic properties: Cheney Mansion, Pleasant Home, and the Oak Park Conservatory
Offers nearly 8,000 recreation programs and special events each year

fullName: Oak Park Public Library Board of Library Trustees
facts: Seven elected trustees govern the library
The library has three locations: the Main Library, Dole Branch, and Maze Branch
Celebrated 120 years as a public library in 2023
Regular board meetings are open to the public, usually on the fourth Wednesday of each month
Governed by a Township Supervisor and four Trustees elected at large
A Township Clerk and Assessor are elected at the same time as the board
Assessor Services helps residents with questions about assessments and property tax bills
Offers senior, youth and family services, plus General Assistance for eligible residents
Its Community Mental Health Board helps plan and fund local mental health services
